_about: Labelled clips for scripts/bench-suite.mjs. Files live outside the repo in DEADEYE_BENCH_DIR. Times in seconds. Clip 1's attempts come from the tracker's own calls on it (10 of 10 right, matching its labelled makes); clip 2's were labelled frame by frame. A clip with "holdout": true runs only when named.

clips.note: 2:39, far and low, two rebounders and a second ball, 31 attempts

2:32, 4 Nov, far and side-on to a wall hoop, smallest rim yet (2.3% of the width), steady, even light, one player who walks past the lens. Cut from 20261104_172123.mp4 at 21.009s (keyframe, stream copy) to 172.5s. 17 attempts, labelled frame by frame

2:46, 4 Nov, low and close, rim near the left edge, same hoop as clip3, two players with passes past the lens, many shots off the backboard. Cut from 20261104_172532.mp4 at 11.014s to 177.5s. 24 attempts, labelled frame by frame

HOLD-OUT: never tune on it; run it once, by name, at the end. Chosen 7 Nov as least like clip1/clip2: very low angle, rim in the top-left corner, two bright light streaks across the picture, two players passing. 3:12, cut from 20261104_172910.mp4 at 31.002s to 223.5s. 29 attempts, labelled frame by frame without running the tracker on it

variants.about: half the pixels each way: a rim far away or small in the picture
a dim gym: darker, flatter, grainy
bright windows behind: low contrast, lifted shadows
a phone scoring 15 frames a second
a slow phone scoring 10 frames a second
a wobbly mount: the picture drifts up to about 0.6% each way
